crossRefs.note: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for…
Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to…
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we…
But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

translations.web: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
translations.bsb: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice and do good while they live,
translations.kjv: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
translations.asv: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to do good so long as they live.
